text:
noah: Heads-up: planning a ~4-month remote stint in Bangkok starting 2026-09-01. Keeping CA homebase. Quick Qs: WFH stipend proration, payroll withholding, health coverage, and shipping my keyboard there.

tara: If homebase stays CA and under 183 days, usually stay on US payroll. Stipend is prorated by full months — 4/12. Submit via Expensify with dates.

payroll-bot: Automated: log Temporary Address in Homebase 7+ days before departure to avoid address/withholding drift. See temp-remote guide: https://redwood.example.com/hr/temp-remote-guidelines

oliver: Benefits: our US medical plan covers emergencies abroad but not routine care. Recommend travel insurance. I'll DM clinics and vendor links.

noah: Keyboard can be shipped? Any customs I should expect?

tara: We can ship; youll be responsible for import duties and customs paperwork. Fill equipment-shipping form and include asset tag.

oliver: Legal note: avoid hiring or contracting in-country without sign-off; that can trigger registration. If you're doing any local meetings with customers, loop legal.

noah: Thanks. I'll file the HRIS temp address, expense, and equipment form this week. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:
